tagline: The Riviera Nayarit's boho-luxury coast — Marietas Islands and coves reached only by boat.
summary: Sayulita and Punta Mita sit at the northern edge of Banderas Bay, a boho-luxury stretch of the Pacific coast. The star waterborne draw is the protected Islas Marietas — famous for the Hidden Beach — reached by permit-controlled boats from the Punta Mita pier, plus coastal hops along the north shore. For Navier Experiences this is a premium island-and-coves node in the same bay as Puerto Vallarta.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II covers the short Marietas and north-shore runs (~4–5 nm) easily.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) is optional here; the core network is well inside Pioneer II all-electric range.

competitive_landscape: Cooperative pangas and tour boats operate on permit; no scheduled premium tier exists.
seasonality: Pacific hurricane season (Jun–Nov); winter–spring is peak. Banderas Bay is large and generally protected.
regulatory_note: Mexican jurisdiction: API/Capitanía de Puerto (SEMAR); Islas Marietas is a protected national park with strict visitor permits.
